pivHint: A snowman's NOSE is a carrot - but to NOSE around is to do what to others' business?
winText: Curious. NOSE was the pivot - a carrot on a snowman to SNOOPing around.
lossText: SNOOP - to pry. NOSE was the pivot: a snowman's NOSE to NOSEing around.
